review_summary: APPROVE: The current Carrier-BRD implementation incrementally extends the existing LaCAM-TAPF execution path without a parallel planner or fallback. It plans the complete active transfer set, commits only through the earliest Drop, globally replans afterward, preserves only carrying task ownership, permits physically legal unrestricted MOVE operations, and prioritizes current unpicked tasks before next-wave continuations. Protected regressions, compatibility tests, the frozen 77-case quick benchmark, and current suite, corpus, and binary hashes were verified. Stale full-run artifacts were excluded from review.
